facts.value: Many countries (particularly Western) have changed their family laws in recent years to accommodate diverse family models.
Domestic violence is violence that happens within the family and may be defined differently in medical, legal, political, or social contexts.

Child maltreatment includes all forms of physical and emotional ill-treatment, sexual abuse, neglect, and exploitation that results in actual or potential harm to the child's health, development, or dignity.
Elder abuse is a single, or repeated act, or lack of appropriate action, occurring within any relationship where there is an expectation of trust which causes harm or distress to an older person.
Forced and child marriages are practiced in certain regions of the world, particularly in Asia and Africa, and are associated with a high rate of domestic violence.
Family honor is an abstract concept involving the perceived quality of worthiness and respectability that affects the social standing and self-evaluation of a group of related people.
Dowry is property that a wife or wife's family gives to her husband when they marry.
Bride price is property paid by the groom or his family to the parents of a woman upon their marriage.
Dower is property given to the bride herself by the groom at the time of marriage, remaining under her ownership and control.
Married couples may benefit from various taxation advantages not available to a single person or unmarried couples.
